text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Sasuga the Satono family! So totally 
celeb-tier~~♡ What else do ya got?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haah♡ Those stories about the Satono 
family were amazing, huh? Celebrities 
really do make your heart throb――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Right, the celebrity special issue! I 
bought it too! Are you into celebrities as 
well, Trainer~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup! 'Cause I wanna be a sparkling 
celebrity, after all♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I got totally swept off my feet during our 
family trip to Dubai ♡ You see, true 
celebrities――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She gets ev~erything she wants! She's so 
poised and cool♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm sure she parties every single 
day! Living life completely her own way! ♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And you know what?! I bet we'll even toast 
each other up in space♪ That sparkle is 
way too big to fit on Earth!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ Celebrities really are amazing~♡ So 
sparkly~ it makes my heart flutter~~♡

Is that really what a celebrity lifestyle 
is like? Doubts crossed my mind, but 
looking into those starry eyes, it would 
be terribly boorish of me to say so.
choice_data_list: Let's charge straight toward that dream!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'll run in races, make a big splash, 
and aim straight for Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Time for that sparkly celeb life♪ I'll do 
my absolute best! Ooh yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heheh~♪ Leave it to me! I've had the 
makings of a celebrity all along anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To get even closer to that true celebrity 
status... Ooh, maybe I should buy that new 
designer bag♡
